changed: Pass by and pass through are now one figure. Both stay in the figure picker under their own names, and a new “Pass type” choice under More options switches a figure between them. Either can now say who passes and in which direction: a pass through can be “neighbor pass through across”, and a pass by can state a direction. Your existing figures read exactly as before.

When you add a pass by or pass through to a dance, choose who passes and the direction before saving; the figure tells you if either is still empty. Figures you saved earlier, or imported, keep any value they leave unstated.

Importing from The Caller's Box now keeps the dancer its pass-through lines name: “Pass through along (NR)” becomes neighbors passing right shoulders. Re-importing a dance you imported before offers those pass throughs as a variation, because the new import says more than the saved figure.

Contra taxonomy v40: `pass_by` is an alias of `pass_through` pinning the new `passType: by`, listed as a move. `pass_through` gains `who` (default `unspecified`) and `passType`; `where` keeps its `along` default, and the alias keeps `who: neighbors` and `where: unspecified` for an omitted param through the new `MoveAlias.defaultParams`. Adds `Taxonomy.defaultParamValue`, `ParamSpec.requiredOnEntry` with `Taxonomy.unstatedRequiredParams`, and `keepOmittedMeaning`, which `applyParamChange` runs when a change re-routes a figure.
